description: This file contains utility functions for creating TensorFlow Summary protocol buffers for various data types and visualization elements in TensorBoard, including scalars, histograms, images, videos, audio, text, PR curves, tensors, and 3D meshes. It also includes functions for data conversion and helper utilities related to tensor and protobuf handling.

methods.name: int half_to_int(f: float)
methods.description: Casts a half-precision float value into an integer.

methods.name: float int_to_half(i: int)
methods.description: Casts an integer value to a half-precision float.

methods.name: hparams(hparam_dict=None, metric_dict=None, hparam_domain_discrete=None)
methods.description: Outputs three Summary protobufs for hyperparameter tuning experiments.

methods.name: scalar(name, tensor, collections=None, new_style=False, double_precision=False)
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf containing a single scalar value.

methods.name: histogram_raw(name, min, max, num, sum, sum_squares, bucket_limits, bucket_counts)
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with a histogram of values.

methods.name: histogram(name, values, bins, max_bins=None)
methods.description: Creates a histogram Summary protobuf from tensor values.

methods.name: make_histogram(values, bins, max_bins=None)
methods.description: Converts values into a histogram protobuf.

methods.name: image(tag, tensor, rescale=1, dataformats="NCHW")
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with image data.

methods.name: image_boxes( tag, tensor_image, tensor_boxes, rescale=1, dataformats="CHW", labels=None )
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with images and bounding boxes.

methods.name: draw_boxes(disp_image, boxes, labels=None)
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes on an image.

methods.name: make_image(tensor, rescale=1, rois=None, labels=None)
methods.description: Converts numpy image array to an Image protobuf.

methods.name: video(tag, tensor, fps=4)
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with video data.

methods.name: make_video(tensor, fps)
methods.description: Encodes a sequence of images into a gif string, returning as a Summary Image.

methods.name: audio(tag, tensor, sample_rate=44100)
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with audio data.

methods.name: custom_scalars(layout)
methods.description: Creates a custom scalar layout and serializes for TensorBoard.

methods.name: text(tag, text)
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf with text data.

methods.name: pr_curve_raw( tag, tp, fp, tn, fn, precision, recall, num_thresholds=127, weights=None )
methods.description: Creates a raw PR curve Summary protobuf from thresholded data.

methods.name: pr_curve(tag, labels, predictions, num_thresholds=127, weights=None)
methods.description: Creates a PR curve Summary protobuf from label and prediction data.

methods.name: compute_curve(labels, predictions, num_thresholds=None, weights=None)
methods.description: Computes True Positive and False Positive counts for PR curve.

methods.name: _get_tensor_summary( name, display_name, description, tensor, content_type, components, json_config )
methods.description: Creates a tensor summary with metadata for 3D tensors.

methods.name: _get_json_config(config_dict)
methods.description: Parses a JSON string from a dictionary for 3JS visualization.

methods.name: mesh( tag, vertices, colors, faces, config_dict, display_name=None, description=None )
methods.description: Creates a Summary protobuf for 3D mesh or point clouds.

methods.name: int _calc_scale_factor(tensor)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: _draw_single_box( image, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, display_str, color="black", color_text="black", thickness=2, )
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: list[float] _tensor_to_complex_val(t: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: list[int] _tensor_to_half_val(t: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: list[Any] _tensor_to_list(t: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: tensor_proto(tag, tensor)
methods.description: unavailable
